headline: Meta unveils camera-free glasses and VR Glasses at Connect
summary: At Meta Connect 2026, Meta introduced its first camera-free smart glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio, and new Meta VR Glasses that sit like eyewear rather than a full headset, priced at $1,300 and using hand and eye tracking. Meta also said it is bringing a Private Processing encryption service to its smart glasses. Outlets differ on how impressive or immersive the new VR Glasses are.

claims.statement: Meta announced its first camera-free smart glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio.

sources.quote: Meta announces Ray-Ban Meta Audio, its first smart glasses without a camera

claims.statement: The camera-free glasses are lighter and have up to 12 hours of battery life.

discrepancies.explanation: Engadget frames the VR Glasses as a Vision Pro-rivaling successor, while The Verge describes the same device more neutrally as new VR hardware in a glasses form factor.
